working_tree: Includes the uncommitted trait changes in this review. Installed CLI builds were not replaced.
reproduction_notes: Scratch harnesses use recorded /tmp paths and inventory; adapt these paths when reproducing elsewhere.
Run emulate-pe.py to recover mapped-0x801a4000.bin; rebuild-mapped-pe.py restores its file layout for emulate-payload.py.
All Windows/macOS APIs remain inert mocked analysis functions, with synthetic host values.
Recorded stage WinHttpConnect port uses the low 16 bits of R8, matching the USHORT API parameter.
